You are suddenly in familiar surroundings.  You notice what appears to
be a large, squat stone structure nearby.  Wait!  That looks like the
tower of your former teacher, Neferet the Green.
However, things are not the same as when you were last here.  Mists and
areas of unexplained darkness surround the tower.  There is movement in
the shadows.
Your teacher would never allow such unaesthetic forms to surround the
tower...  unless something were dreadfully wrong!
--More--

"Come closer, wizard, for my voice falters in my old age.
Yes, I see that you have come a long way since you went out into the
world, leaving the safe confines of this tower.  However, I must first
determine if you have all of the skills required to take on the task
I require of you."
--More--

"Alas, wizard, you have not yet shown your proficiency as a worthy
spellcaster.  As an Evoker, you would surely be overcome in the challenge
ahead.  Go, now, expand your horizons, and return when you have attained
renown as an Enchanter."

cases.selectionRationale: The saved iron-golem witness takes a fire ray through zhitu after acid damage; the dragon breath witness uses the resistant red-dragon branch. cases.selectionRationale: The closest cursed-grease regression disarms an adjacent board and moves the hero into it on failure; the standing-board grease regression uses an uncursed tool and reaches repair. C v53 stands on the revealed board and uses charged cursed grease. bad_tool is true, short-circuiting untrap_prob; the observed first RNG at137 is rnl(5). With dx=dy=0: failure137 squeaks B flat without the adjacent movement continuation, and the board remains under the hero. The cursed in-place failure differs from adjacent trap entry and successful uncursed repair.

You find yourself standing in sight of the Great Temple.  Something
is obviously wrong here.  The doors to the Great Temple, which usually
stand open, are closed.  Strange human shapes shamble around
outside.
You realize that the Arch Priest needs your assistance!
--More--

"Ah, wizard, my son.  You have returned to us at last.
A great blow has befallen our order; perhaps you can help us.
First, however, I must determine if you are prepared for this
great challenge."
--More--

"Yes, wizard.  You are truly ready now.  Attend to me and I shall
tell you of what has transpired:
"At one of the Great Festivals a short time ago, Nalzok and a legion
of undead invaded the Great Temple.  Many Acolytes were killed, including
the one carrying the Mitre of Holiness.
"As a final act of vengefulness, Nalzok desecrated the altar here.
Without it, we could not mount a counter-attack.  Now, there are
barely enough Acolytes left to keep the undead at bay.
"We need you to find the Temple of Nalzok, then, from there, travel
to Nalzok's lair.  If you can manage to defeat Nalzok and return
the Mitre of Holiness here, we can then drive off the legions of
undead that befoul the land.
"Go with Raijin as your guide, wizard."
--More--
